messages:
maya: hey all, new hire here. tried to run the CI pipeline from the onboarding PR and Buildkite fails immediately with a GH app error. any quick checks?

devopsbot: Tip: common causes -> GitHub App not granted repo access, stale agent token, or missing GCR creds. See onboarding docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/onboarding/ci

maya: error from agent logs: 
``
2026-03-24T11:05:02Z ERROR register: 403 Forbidden - github app installation missing repository access
```

sam: welcome! Did you install the "Redwood CI" GitHub App to your personal account or the org? If it's not installed on the org/repo Buildkite can't create checks.

maya: i clicked the install link but i think it added only to my user. where do i change that?

li: GitHub -> Organization settings -> Installed GitHub Apps -> Redwood CI -> Configure. Either set to "All repositories" or add the specific repo (infra/onboarding-sandbox). After that re-run the Buildkite webhook registration from the pipeline settings.

sam: also double-check the buildkite agent token on your machine. onboarding DMs sometimes contain short-lived tokens. On the build host: `sudo cat /etc/buildkite-agent/buildkite-agent.cfg` and regenerate at Buildkite -> Teams -> Agents -> New token (scope: agent) if needed, then `sudo systemctl restart buildkite-agent`.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #312 failed: Job 'ci:unit' exited 1. Logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding/312

maya: i don't have org admin to change the app. sam, can infra expand it?

sam: sure, pinging infra admin. If you can't get org access today we can add the repo specifically. Also FYI infra rotates join tokens weekly so always grab a fresh agent token after joining.

li: infra granted repo access. Maya, after that's done regenerate agent token, restart agent, and re-trigger the build.

maya: regenerated token and restarted the agent, retriggering now...

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #313 started: https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding/313

maya: build passed! thanks for the help. who should I ping if my tokens get revoked or the app loses access later?

li: Ping #eng-infra and tag @sam or @devopsbot. We'll add you to the agent rotation doc and the onboarding checklist. welcome aboard! :wave:
